title: Pong: The Beginning
pitch: Classic neon Pong against a CPU paddle, first to 7.
coreLoop: Move your paddle to return the ball; angle shots off the paddle edge to beat the CPU.
mechanics: ball speeds up on every paddle hit
hit position on the paddle sets the return angle
CPU paddle tracks the ball with limited speed

entities.name: ball
entities.description: white square with a short trail

artDirection: Dark background, dashed center line, glowing neon rectangles, big score digits.
audio: Short square-wave blips for paddle and wall hits, a low tone on a point.
difficulty: CPU max speed is slightly below the ball's top speed so rallies are winnable.
acceptance: Menu shows the title and 'Press SPACE'
Ball moves and bounces off top and bottom walls
Scores update when the ball passes a paddle
Game ends at 7 and shows a win or lose screen
